# Markdown Share

> Turn plain markdown into clean, permanent pages. Write it yourself, or let your agent publish it over MCP. No account required; shares are unlisted by default.

Agents can publish and read shares through the Model Context Protocol.

- Endpoint: https://api.markdownshare.shaheerahamed.com/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP, stateless (one JSON-RPC message per POST, JSON responses)
- Authentication: none, no API keys or accounts
- `create_share({ content, title?, description?, idempotencyKey? })`: publishes markdown and returns a link. Content is required (max 4 MB). Title and description are truncated to 70 and 180 characters. `idempotencyKey` must be a UUID; replaying it returns the original share. Shares created over MCP are always unlisted.
- `get_share(id)`: reads a share by id and returns it as text. Never increments the view count.

To connect in a client that supports Streamable HTTP, add a server named `markdown-share` with `"type": "http"` and the endpoint URL above. In Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http markdown-share https://api.markdownshare.shaheerahamed.com/mcp`

Suggested agent prompt: when asked to share, publish, or hand off a markdown document, call `create_share` with the full document and a short title, then return the link. Use `get_share` when given a Markdown Share link.

## Raw markdown

Append `.md` to any share link to get the document itself: `https://markdownshare.shaheerahamed.com/share/<id>.md` returns `text/markdown` with no envelope and no rendering. Reading it never increments the view count, so it is the cheapest way for an agent to fetch a share it was given as a URL.

All REST responses use the envelope `{ success, message, code, data? }`.

## API

- [Create share](https://api.markdownshare.shaheerahamed.com/api/v1/create/share): POST with body `{ content, isUnlisted, title?, description?, idempotencyKey? }`
- [Read share](https://api.markdownshare.shaheerahamed.com/api/v1/read/share): GET with `?id=<uuid>`, returns one share with its content
- [Latest shares](https://api.markdownshare.shaheerahamed.com/api/v1/read/latest-shares): GET with `?limit=<n>`, public shares newest first (default 28, max 100)

## Web

- [Landing page and editor](https://markdownshare.shaheerahamed.com/): landing page, agent demo and editor
- [Create a share](https://markdownshare.shaheerahamed.com/new): create a share in the browser
- [Public shares](https://markdownshare.shaheerahamed.com/list): public shares, newest first
